title: Phân hệ 2: Danh mục & Thông tin Sản phẩm (Physical ERD)
code:
erDiagram
    CATEGORY {
        int CategoryID PK
        varchar CategoryName
        varchar Description
    }
    SUBCATEGORY {
        int SubcategoryID PK
        int CategoryID FK
        varchar SubcategoryName
    }
    PRODUCT_TYPE {
        int ProductTypeID PK
        int SubcategoryID FK
        varchar TypeName
    }
    PRODUCT {
        int ProductID PK
        int ProductTypeID FK
        varchar ProductName
        decimal UnitPrice
        decimal PromotionPrice
        datetime ExpiredDate
        varchar ImageUrl
        decimal WeightOrVolume
        varchar Unit
        text Description
        varchar Status
        int SubstituteProductID FK
        varchar SKU
    }
    PRODUCT_HEALTHTAG {
        int ProductID PK,FK
        int HealthTagID PK,FK
    }
